The European Court of Human Rights (Grand Chamber, 21 November 2001) found no violation of Article 6(1) in Al-Adsani v. United Kingdom. By a narrow 9–8 majority, it held that the UK's grant of state immunity to Kuwait in a civil suit over alleged torture was a proportionate restriction pursuing a legitimate aim. It reasoned that international law at that time did not recognize an exception to state immunity for civil claims over torture committed abroad.

CONFIDENCE: 96
